messages:
eva: deploybot stuck promoting canary for rev 2026.03.14-rc3 — pipeline failing at artifact cache restore (mount EIO). saw s3 read errors in the job log. @deploybot any retries planned?

deploybot: promotion paused (auto). failing job: ci/integration/acceptance [build 8241] — error: mount /var/lib/runner/cache: I/O error. queued auto-retry 1/3 in 30s.

tom: I can reproduce on a staging runner with a high-concurrency load. nfs cache mount flakes; /dev/nvme0p1 shows I/O errors. short logs: `read error: io error 5` repeated. linking full logs: https://internal.logs/8241 (redacted).

jen: we have a decision to make: pin to the last-good artifact digest and promote, or wait for infra fix? our change window ends in ~40m.

maya: +1 for pinning to unblock the release. no DB migrations in this rollout (confirmed).

tom: confirmed no migrations. suggested pin command:
```
# pin and promote previous artifact
deploybot promote --env=prod-canary --to-digest sha256:abc123def4567890
```

eva: @release-manager can you update release notes to reflect a temporary pin and a follow-up infra investigation? we should also call out the workaround in the changelog.

release-manager: will update release notes now and add a follow-up task. scheduling a short postmortem with infra + eng-sre after rollout.

oncall-ci: starting health checks on the runner pool (disk/kernel). as a temporary workaround we can re-run the acceptance job with cache disabled: set CI_CACHE=false for the job. that avoids the flaky mount.

jen: ok run it with cache disabled and see if tests are stable. aware that disabling cache will slow the job but better than blocking the release.

tom: triggered rerun with CI_CACHE=false (build 8243). quick note: this is a low-risk change because no migrations.

deploybot: build 8243 running. will report back on success/failure.

(8 minutes later)

tom: build 8243 finished: all acceptance tests passed. logs show no cache-mount errors.

deploybot: promotion unblocked: promoted canary to 10% traffic for rev 2026.03.14-rc3 (pinned to sha256:abc123def4567890). manual final cutover planned after 1h observation.

eva: decision recap: pin to last-good digest, rerun acceptance with CI_CACHE=false to avoid flaky mount, promote canary. release notes updated and postmortem ticket filed. send a brief to #all-hands about potential runner disk flapping.

maya: filing INFRA-5023 to investigate runner hardware and NFS gateway. assigned to eng-sre.

jen: thanks everyone. please monitor canary metrics; if any regression in 1h we rollback to previous stable (promote --to-digest sha256:prevstable). :thumbsup:

deploybot: noting actions: (1) pin applied, (2) canary promotion at 10%, (3) manual cutover pending, (4) alerts set for latency and error-rate thresholds.
